ib/ma_announced.title: Announced M&A deal value
ib/ma_announced.why: Deals are announced months before close, locking in advisory and financing fees well ahead of reported revenue.
ib/ma_announced.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence monthly M&A review
ib/ma_announced.note: No confirmed public time series; LSEG publishes press-release summaries only.

ib/ipo_pipeline.title: IPO pipeline — S-1 filing counts
ib/ipo_pipeline.why: Registration filings precede pricing by ~1-3 months, signaling ECM fee flow before it books.
ib/ipo_pipeline.note: EDGAR API is public but a filing-count pipeline is not yet built.

ib/hy_issuance.title: High-yield bond issuance
ib/hy_issuance.why: HY windows open and shut quickly; issuance surges/shutdowns lead DCM fees and flag shifts in credit risk appetite.
ib/hy_issuance.note: SIFMA publishes free research; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

ib/ib_fee_wallet.title: IB fee league-table trackers
ib/ib_fee_wallet.why: Fee estimates from announced/completed deals publish weeks before banks' quarterly filings.
ib/ib_fee_wallet.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence quarterly IB Review
ib/ib_fee_wallet.note: Press-release summaries only; no public series.

ficc/move_index.title: MOVE Index (rates implied vol)
ficc/move_index.why: Implied Treasury vol reprices ahead of policy surprises and duration-driven deleveraging.
ficc/move_index.note: Licensed index; no free public daily series confirmed.

ficc/hy_oas.title: US High Yield OAS
ficc/hy_oas.why: HY spreads price default/liquidity risk months before realized defaults.

ficc/ig_oas.title: US Investment Grade OAS
ficc/ig_oas.why: IG spread companion to HY; investment-grade stress gauge.

ficc/mbs_spread.title: Agency MBS spread (30Y mortgage − 30Y Treasury)
ficc/mbs_spread.why: MBS widening signals dealer balance-sheet constraints and convexity-hedging pressure before broad funding stress.

ficc/wti_spot.title: WTI crude spot
ficc/wti_spot.why: Real-economy demand signal orthogonal to the heat map's price/stock quarterly metrics.
ficc/wti_spot.note: Calendar spread (prompt − 12M futures) needs a futures curve; spot is the verified public component.

equities/put_call.title: CBOE equity put/call ratio
equities/put_call.why: Options-positioning extremes flag crowded sentiment 1-several weeks before price turns.
equities/put_call.note: Free historical CSV frozen at 2019-10-04; current data requires scraping the daily page.

equities/cape_zscore.title: Cyclically adjusted P/E vs 10-yr mean
equities/cape_zscore.why: Starting valuation is the most robust predictor of medium-horizon returns.
equities/cape_zscore.note: Yale file unreachable/stale as of 2026-10; no confirmed current public series.

equities/equity_issuance.title: US IPO + follow-on issuance volume
equities/equity_issuance.why: Treasurers time equity supply to peak demand; issuance surges cluster near cycle tops.
equities/equity_issuance.note: Free charts; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

equities/factor_rotation.title: High-beta minus low-vol 60-day relative strength
equities/factor_rotation.why: Rotations into high-beta leadership precede broad index turns as late-cycle risk appetite peaks.
equities/factor_rotation.note: Needs a reliable free ETF price feed; tested sources are bot-walled.

awm/fund_flows.title: Net flows to long-term mutual funds & ETFs
awm/fund_flows.why: Redemption/allocation shifts move AUM and fee bases weeks before reported revenue.
awm/fund_flows.note: ICI publishes weekly Excel workbooks; direct download URL unconfirmed (page is bot-walled).

awm/mmf_assets.title: Money-market fund total assets
awm/mmf_assets.why: Sharp MMF inflows signal flight-to-cash and liquidity hoarding, presaging risk-asset outflows.

awm/sp500.title: S&P 500 level
awm/sp500.why: Market beta drives most AUM change; drawdowns lead AUM erosion and fee declines.

firmwide/cp_ois.title: 3M CP–OIS spread
firmwide/cp_ois.why: CP is the marginal unsecured funding market; spreads reprice within days as risk appetite erodes.
firmwide/cp_ois.source: Constructed: Fed commercial paper rates − 3M OIS
firmwide/cp_ois.note: No confirmed public 3M OIS series; spread cannot be built from verified inputs.

firmwide/fra_ois.title: 3M×3M FRA–OIS spread
firmwide/fra_ois.why: Prices forward unsecured term-funding risk plus embedded bank counterparty credit.

firmwide/margin_debt.title: FINRA margin debt (debit balances)
firmwide/margin_debt.why: Client leverage builds/unwinds ahead of forced deleveraging; peaks precede volatility cascades.

firmwide/dealer_cds.title: Dealer 5Y senior CDS (average)
firmwide/dealer_cds.why: Market-implied default intensity of counterparties widens before CVA losses or rating actions.

plumbing/sofr_iorb.title: SOFR–IORB spread
plumbing/sofr_iorb.why: The spread of overnight secured funding to the Fed's administered rate is the corridor's thermometer: when SOFR sits below IORB, reserves are abundant and cash is seeking alternatives.
plumbing/sofr_iorb.note: IORB starts 2021-07-29, which limits the backfill.

plumbing/on_rrp.title: ON RRP take-up
plumbing/on_rrp.why: Cash parked in the Fed's overnight reverse repo facility is cash not funding markets; a collapse toward zero means cash is no longer seeking the Fed's balance sheet, i.e. reserves are no longer abundant.

plumbing/dealer_fails.title: Primary dealer fails-to-deliver
plumbing/dealer_fails.why: Fails-to-deliver spike when Treasury settlement chains seize — the observable footprint of settlement stress in the world's deepest market.
plumbing/dealer_fails.source: NY Fed primary-dealer statistics (11 Treasury fails-to-deliver series, summed)
plumbing/dealer_fails.note: Sum of 11 Treasury fails-to-deliver codes (-TD); values of "*" are suppressed below the confidentiality threshold and treated as 0.

plumbing/fhlb.title: FHLB advances
plumbing/fhlb.why: Federal Home Loan Bank advances are banks' wholesale funding tap of first resort when deposits flee — a surge flags liquidity stress before it reaches the discount window.
plumbing/fhlb.source: FHLB Office of Finance Combined Financial Reports (CFR)
plumbing/fhlb.note: Parsed from CFR PDFs (MD&A advances figure). Older CFRs live under different URL paths and are not chased, so the series covers the quarters the current URL pattern reaches (2025Q2 onward as of 2026-10); unpublished quarters are skipped.

plumbing/treasury_basis.title: Treasury cash–futures basis (proxy)
plumbing/treasury_basis.why: A wider (more positive) basis means cash Treasuries cheapen relative to futures — the classic footprint of dealer balance-sheet constraints.
plumbing/treasury_basis.source: Computed: FRED DGS10 minus Yahoo ZN=F implied yield
plumbing/treasury_basis.note: Proxy: futures-implied yield of a hypothetical 6%-coupon 10-year note at the quoted futures price. Abstracts from the cheapest-to-deliver option, delivery timing, and repo financing effects.

plumbing/xccy_basis.title: EUR/USD cross-currency basis (CIP construction)
plumbing/xccy_basis.why: A negative basis means synthetic dollar funding via EUR costs more than direct dollars — the offshore dollar-shortage thermometer.
plumbing/xccy_basis.source: Constructed: CME Euro FX futures + FRED DEXUSEU, DGS3MO, IR3TIB01EZM156N (Du–Tepper–Verdelhan)
plumbing/xccy_basis.note: Experimental DIY construction; EUR leg only; series starts 2025-04 (Yahoo delists expired futures contracts). The FRED Euribor input is stale and the T-bill leg is not banks' marginal funding rate — watch changes, not levels.

positioning/cftc_cot.title: Speculative rate-futures z-scores
positioning/cftc_cot.why: Leveraged-fund net positioning at extremes has preceded sharp rate repricings — crowded trades unwind violently.
positioning/cftc_cot.note: Four contracts (UST 2Y/5Y/10Y notes, 3M SOFR): leveraged-fund net (long − short) z-scored against its trailing 104-week window, current week excluded.

positioning/etf_dislocation.title: Corporate bond ETF dislocation (proxy)
positioning/etf_dislocation.why: An ETF trading far below its own recent average price is the observable footprint of a price/NAV dislocation (e.g. March 2020, when LQD/HYG traded at steep discounts and mean-reverted).
positioning/etf_dislocation.source: Yahoo Finance: LQD, HYG vs trailing 20-day mean
positioning/etf_dislocation.note: Proxy: (close − 20d MA) / 20d MA. The true (market price − NAV)/NAV leg is not published in machine-readable form — documented as a proxy, not the accounting discount.

positioning/cds_bond_basis.title: Excess Bond Premium (CDS–bond basis proxy)
positioning/cds_bond_basis.why: The excess bond premium isolates the non-default (liquidity/funding) component of corporate spreads — exactly what the CDS–bond basis measures (Bai & Collin-Dufresne, 2019).
positioning/cds_bond_basis.source: Federal Reserve FEDS Notes EBP series (Gilchrist–Zakrajšek methodology)
positioning/cds_bond_basis.note: Direction matches dealer-quoted basis (spikes when funding stress widens it); levels are NOT comparable to dealer CDS quotes — compare deviations/spikes, not absolute levels.

positioning/insider_selling.title: Bank insider net selling
positioning/insider_selling.why: Insiders sell ahead of bad news more often than they buy ahead of good — persistent net open-market selling by bank officers is a sentiment gauge for the sector.
positioning/insider_selling.source: OpenInsider (SEC Form 4 filings): JPM, BAC, C, WFC, GS, MS, USB, PNC
positioning/insider_selling.note: Each ticker page lists only recent transactions, so the trailing ~12 months are the usable window. Amendments/duplicates are not de-duplicated — treat the level as approximate, the month-to-month changes as the signal.

filings/htm_unrealized.title: Bank HTM unrealized losses
filings/htm_unrealized.why: Unrealized losses on held-to-maturity securities are the unrealized-capital hole that forced sales crystallize — the SVB lesson in aggregate.
filings/htm_unrealized.source: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile (QBP), aggregate workbook
filings/htm_unrealized.note: Balance-sheet row "Held to maturity on non-equity securities unrealized gain/loss"; reported as gain/loss in $ millions (losses negative), sign-flipped so positive values are losses.

filings/n_mfp.title: MMF repo counterparty concentration
filings/n_mfp.why: Repo is the marginal funding market; when a handful of dealers dominate money-fund repo, a single counterparty wobble propagates.
filings/n_mfp.source: SEC DERA Form N-MFP monthly data sets
filings/n_mfp.note: Top-3 dealer share ≈ 27.13% under the verified methodology (sponsored-repo rows attributed to the named sponsor dealer; residual unmapped volume excluded from the dealer ranking) — supersedes the earlier 14.6% print, which used a different attribution.

filings/earnings_calls.title: Bank earnings-call credit language
filings/earnings_calls.why: Management language on credit quality, reserves, and provisions shifts before the charge-offs show up in the numbers.
filings/earnings_calls.source: Motley Fool earnings-call transcripts (JPM, BAC, WFC)
filings/earnings_calls.note: v1 methodology proof, not a production time series: verified on Q3 2026 calls (JPM 7.6 / BAC 11.6 / WFC 8.9 per 10k words); the framework caught JPMorgan's actual $539m reserve build.

crossmarket/wti_calendar_spread.title: WTI calendar spread (prompt−12M)
crossmarket/wti_calendar_spread.why: Backwardation means a tight physical market and low inventories; contango means glut. The slope of the curve is the physical market's stress gauge.
crossmarket/wti_calendar_spread.source: Yahoo Finance: CL=F front month minus the contract expiring ~12 months later
crossmarket/wti_calendar_spread.note: Trailing ~12 months of history only — Yahoo delists expired contracts, so the 12M leg exists only where the contract is still listed.
